name: Adani Enterprises

snapshot.about: Adani Enterprises Limited operates an infrastructure-focused incubator portfolio spanning energy, utilities, transport, logistics, and primary industry.

narrative: Management met airport traffic targets with 95.3 million passengers in FY26 against their guidance of just short of 100 million. However, Q1 FY27 posted a net loss of ₹1,462 crore despite revenue growing 49.9% to ₹32,924 crore.

cash.read: Operating cash flow covered reported profits over FY22–FY26, but heavy capital expenditure caused negative free cash flow in four out of five years while inventory days expanded significantly.

bull.point: Airport segment demonstrated strong operational momentum, achieving 95.3 million passengers and ₹5,394 crore EBITDA in FY26.

evidence.quote: Financial performance during '25-'26, we had passenger traffic of 95.3 million passengers, total income of INR13,081 crores, up by 28% year-over-year
and EBITDA increased by 55% to INR5,394 crores on account of tariff revisions and non-aero growth

bull.point: Cumulative five-year operating cash flow of ₹36,193 crore comfortably covered total reported profits of ₹24,501 crore.

evidence.quote: Over FY22–FY26, operating cash flow of ₹36,193 crore covered all of reported profit, ₹24,501 crore.
evidence.source: Computed from screener.in's cash-flow statement and ratios

bull.point: Third-party independent reviews were conducted to assure the Audit Committee that related party transactions were conducted on an arm's length basis.

evidence.quote: your Company has engaged independent third party for assessment of related party transactions and providing assurance to the Audit Committee that all the transactions were at arm’s length basis

bear.point: Massive capital expenditure generated severe cash drain, resulting in negative total free cash flow of ₹75,217 crore across four of the last five years.

evidence.quote: Free cash flow was negative in 4 of 5 years, −₹75,217 crore in total.
evidence.source: Computed from screener.in's cash-flow statement and ratios

bear.point: Working capital efficiency deteriorated significantly as inventory days widened from 69 to 126 days between FY24 and FY26.

evidence.quote: Inventory days rose from 69 to 126 between FY24 and FY26: cash is waiting longer in the business.
evidence.source: Computed from screener.in's cash-flow statement and ratios

bear.point: The auditor noted that substantial loans given to group entities were renewed or extended prior to their due dates during the year.

evidence.quote: certain loans given to companies which are falling due during the year has been renewed/ extended prior to the due date
